source: Google Trends via SerpAPI (engine=google_trends, geo=US, data_type=TIMESERIES, date=2024-10-01 2026-11-08)
method: Average weekly interest for weeks starting 2026-09-27..2026-11-01 vs 2025-09-28..2025-11-02. Each request is its own 0-100 scale; growth compares a term with itself. Terms averaging under 1 point in either window are not reported as growth.
